description: Generate a QR code and return it as an SVG image. All generation happens locally in this process — nothing is sent to any server, matching UnlimitedQRCodes.com's own privacy-by-design approach. Supported types: url (URL), text (Plain text), wifi (WiFi network), vcard (Contact card (vCard)), email (Email), phone (Phone call), sms (SMS), whatsapp (WhatsApp), location (Map location), event (Calendar event). Each type needs different fields; call list_qr_types for the exact required/optional field list per type if unsure.

address.description: Required for type 'location'. A place name or street address.

backgroundColor.description: Hex color for the background. Defaults to #ffffff.

endDate.description: For type 'event'. Defaults to startDate. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

foregroundColor.description: Hex color for the QR modules. Defaults to #000000.

hidden.description: For type 'wifi'. Whether the network is hidden. Defaults to false.

location.description: For type 'event'. Where the event takes place.

password.description: For type 'wifi'. Leave unset for open networks.

ssid.description: Required for type 'wifi'. The WiFi network name.

text.description: Required for type 'text'. Any plain text message.

title.description: Required for type 'event'. The event title.

to.description: Required for type 'email'. The recipient address.

type.description: Which kind of QR code to generate. Call list_qr_types first if you're unsure which fields each type needs.

url.description: Required for type 'url'. The link to encode, e.g. https://example.com.

name: generate_qr_code
title: Generate QR code
